answer: A convincing sybil defense is slow trust: every agent account carries a jade trust token whose weight grows as age times honest epochs, so influence compounds only through verifiable history. New identities like comet arrivals start near zero and cannot buy acceleration; each account needs real epochs of honest participation before its votes or trades move markets. An attacker spawning a plume of fresh agents gains almost nothing per account, since the cost is months of honest activity per identity, making mass fakes uneconomical compared to keeping one good reputation.
